QuestInfo.name: Moonlight Bard
QuestInfo.0: Tell Grandpa Moon Bunny that you've played Moonlight Sonata for Baby Moon Bunny.
QuestInfo.1: Grandpa Moon Bunny thanks you for bringing the Moonlight Sonata Music Box to Baby Moon Bunny.  The sound of Baby Moon Bunny's music box playing Moonlight Sonata beautifully resonates on the small, peaceful moon.
